subject: Vendor activation sprint: procurement checklist & target close
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + vendor activation sprint (first pass)

Hi Asha — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed sprint for vendor activation so your procurement team can get us live by end of Q2: 

Summary from today's call:
- Goal: Redwood in production for Helios internal tools (search & summarization) by 2027-06-30.
- Procurement owner: Asha (you) and procurement@helioshealth.com; technical owner: Puneet (your infra).
- Primary onboarding path: Ariba or Coupa preferred (you mentioned Ariba as the likely current system).

Proposed vendor activation sprint (high-level milestones & owners):
1) Vendor paperwork intake — Helios procurement: complete vendor form + W-9 (Dependency: legal sign-off window, target 3 business days).
2) Banking & payment setup — Helios finance: provide ACH/Remit details + banking spreadsheet (Dependency: treasury verification, target 5 business days).
3) Ariba/Coupa enrollment — Helios procurement + Redwood finance: submit vendor in Ariba/Coupa, exchange vendor IDs (Dependency: Ariba supplier onboarding window, target 7 business days).
4) PO & billing terms — Helios procurement & Redwood sales: confirm invoicing cadence and PO templates (Dependency: PO generation, target 3 business days after Ariba enrollment).
5) Technical enablement & SSO — Helios infra & Redwood infra: test SSO, network allowlist (Dependency: IT change window, target 10 business days).

I've attached a short intake packet with the vendor form and a sample W-9 to speed intake.

Next steps (asks):
- Asha: please confirm preferred procurement system (Ariba or Coupa) and estimated onboarding SLA from your side.
- Procurement team: reply to this thread with point of contact and earliest window to receive vendor paperwork.
- Redwood: Marissa will lead the vendor submission to our finance team and coordinate DocuSign for the master services schedule.

If this looks right, I'll produce a concise sprint checklist with dates and a single-pane MAP so we can track dependencies.

Thanks —

Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
loganw@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
[Attachment: Helios_Vendor_Form.pdf (PDF, 42KB)] [Attachment: Sample_W9.pdf (PDF, 14KB)]

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@helioshealth.com>

Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + vendor activation sprint (first pass)

Thanks, Logan — good summary. A few notes from procurement: 

- We use Ariba. Typical supplier onboarding takes ~5–10 business days if paperwork is complete.
- I'll be the intake owner for the vendor packet; please send all forms to procurement@helioshealth.com.
- For W-9 and banking, treasury needs certified copies for ACH; banking spreadsheet works fine.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Preferred system: Ariba (confirmed).
- Point of contact: procurement@helioshealth.com (triage inbox) and I will be the POC for escalations.
- Earliest window: we can start intake tomorrow; realistic completion target is 2027-03-22 given our internal approvals.

I'll loop in our finance lead if we need faster ACH setup. For now, please share the vendor packet into the procurement inbox and I will confirm receipt.

—Asha
Asha Menon
Director, Procurement, Helios Health
asha.menon@helioshealth.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@helioshealth.com, Asha Menon <asha.menon@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Vendor packet + concise sprint checklist (please confirm dates)

Hi Asha / procurement team — attaching the concise sprint checklist and the banking instructions spreadsheet for your treasury team. For transparency I added estimated durations; please update if your internal SLAs differ.

Sprint checklist (dates below are our ask; please confirm or revise):
- 2027-03-09: Redwood sends completed vendor packet + DocuSign MSS (ACTION: Redwood — Logan).
- 2027-03-11: Helios confirms receipt & uploads to Ariba (ACTION: Helios procurement).
- 2027-03-15: Treasury provides certified ACH details (ACTION: Helios finance).
- 2027-03-18: Ariba supplier ID issued & PO template confirmed (ACTION: Helios procurement + Redwood finance).
- 2027-03-22: Test invoice on agreed cadence; provisioning checklist begins (ACTION: Redwood infra + Helios infra).

Open dependencies / risks:
- If Ariba enrollment takes longer than 7 business days, target close may slip past 2027-06-30.
- DocuSign MSS needs legal review; if Helios legal requests redlines we may need up to 5 business days to respond.

Attachments: Helios_Vendor_Form.pdf, Sample_W9.pdf, Banking_Instructions.xlsx, MAP_Checklist_helio_v1.docx (map draft inline).

Marissa: per our playbook can you own the DocuSign flow and coordinate any finance billing items?
Ben: quick note on invoicing cadence — we prefer Net 30 by default; we can be flexible if treasury needs Net 45.

Looking forward to your confirmation so we can lock dates.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Vendor packet + concise sprint checklist (please confirm dates)

Hi Asha — looping in Lauren from Redwood Finance to speed treasury setup. A couple of practical notes from our side that help speed Ariba/Coupa enrollment: 

1) Please paste the vendor legal name exactly as it appears on your W-9 into Ariba to avoid mismatches.
2) For ACH: include both routing and SWIFT (if international) and a copy of a voided check or bank letter — Helios treasury asked for certified proof.
3) If Ariba requires a tax ID verification step, we can expedite by sharing our vendor registration packet (please advise).

Lauren, can you confirm Redwood's billing contact and the default remit address for Helios PO setup?

Asha / procurement: if you confirm the 2027-03-11 upload to Ariba, we will prioritize DocuSign so legal review can happen concurrently.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
